title: The 5 Widest Wingspans Ever Built, Ranked (#2 Flew Once)

scenes.text: The five widest wingspans ever built. Number two flew exactly once, for under a mile.
Number five: the Antonov An-124 Ruslan. Seventy-three meters from wingtip to wingtip, a giant cargo jet.
scenes.label: An-124 Ruslan · 73 m

scenes.text: Number four: the Airbus A380. Eighty meters across, the largest passenger airliner ever built.
scenes.label: Airbus A380 · 80 m

scenes.text: Number three: the Antonov An-225 Mriya. Eighty-eight meters wide, the only one ever flown, destroyed in 2022.
scenes.label: An-225 Mriya · 88 m

scenes.text: Number two: the Hughes H-4 Hercules. Ninety-eight meters wide, it flew once in 1947 and never again.
scenes.label: Hughes H-4 · 98 m

scenes.text: Number one: the Stratolaunch Roc. A hundred seventeen meters wide, wider than a football field.
scenes.label: Stratolaunch Roc · 117 m

description:
The five widest wingspans ever built, ranked.
The Stratolaunch Roc is 117 meters wide, and the Hughes H-4 Hercules flew exactly once, on November 2, 1947.
Which one would you most want to see in the air?
first_comment: Which of these would you have wanted to fly in? And what should we rank next?
